title: 第11章  龙鱼身法，杀道王拳！
content_zh:
“方玄，我虽然不知道你哪来的勇气，但我会用事实告诉你。”
定下赌约之后，苏晨一脸讥讽的看着方玄。
“你会死得很难看的。”
方玄反击道：“你这条命，我要定了！”
“那就看你有没有这个本事！”
苏晨冷笑一声，朝着武楼拱手道：“还请前辈见证，今日我和方玄，以武楼对赌，生死各安天命。”
“准了！”
武楼虽然禁止动武，但双方既然愿意赌命，武楼自然不会拦着。
得到答复后，苏晨脸上笑容更胜。
让武楼镇守者作证，就是为了上一道保险，免得方玄耍赖。
“方玄，等着吧。”
苏晨看向方玄，说道：“等你死了，你方家自会把你妹妹，送到我苏家来。”
方玄的妹妹可是方家嫡系。
若是成为他苏家门房的小妾，这可是对方家巨大的羞辱。
闻言，方玄眼中杀机更浓。
这苏晨，羞辱他也就算了。
但敢羞辱他妹妹，那就必须死！
“方玄，要不还是算了吧。”
方雨容竭力劝说道：“为了一时义气，白白丢掉性命，并不明智。”
她打定主意。

只要方玄先低头，她付出一切，也会保住方玄性命。
“现在反悔已经晚了。”
苏晨冷笑道：“方雨容，即便你是问道宗弟子，也阻止不了我杀方玄。”
说完，苏晨缴纳了元石，大步跨入武楼。
“谁杀谁，可不一定！”
方玄眼神冷漠，在所有人的注视下，缴纳元石后，进入武楼。
......
这是一片广袤的平原。
四周空无一物。
“唰！”
破空声响起，一道身影落在平原之上。
现出方玄的身形。
他打量着四周，脸上不由得浮现惊叹之色。
“好玄妙的阵法。”
九帝传承中，有一位阵霄女帝，号称阵法之祖，擅长诸天阵法，一手《三千阵图》，可谓是出神入化，能够阵压万界。
方玄虽得传承，但还未曾修炼。
不过，他却能够看出，眼前的平原，乃是一门极为高深玄妙的阵法演化出来的环境。
“看来，这天宝楼，还真是深不可测啊。”
单单创建的这座武楼，就让人心生震撼。
在方玄身边，有一座无字石碑。

每个进入武楼的挑战者，只有在石碑上留下名字，留下神魂烙印，才能开启挑战。
方玄抬手，以指作笔，在石碑上写下自己的名字，同时留下神魂烙印。
方玄二字后面，跟随着一个小小的一字。
证明方玄当前处于武楼第一层。
与此同时，武楼外的石碑上，一个毫不起眼的名字，浮现在那无数名字之中。
“也不知道，此次会遇到什么。”
刚将手指收回，方玄顿时察觉到地面传来一阵轻微的抖动。
他抬眼看去，只见平原尽头，一抹黑点飞速变大。
不过眨眼之间，就化作一头牛犊般大小的妖兽，朝着方玄狂奔而来。
妖兽身上，是一片片厚重鳞甲。
鳞甲上，还布满根根倒刺，散发出腥臭的气息。
一阶妖兽，毒刺甲牛！
毒刺甲牛身上的倒刺中，蕴含着剧烈的毒性，
一旦刺伤皮肤，剧毒入体，就算是炼体境武者，不能得到及时救治，也会毒发身亡。
当然，在这武楼幻境之中。
武者虽然不会死亡，但神魂也会受到创伤。
严重者，更会因此阻碍修行之路。
“咚咚咚！”
毒刺甲牛快若奔雷，一双猩红牛眼中，只有方玄。
方玄眼中精光闪烁，在毒刺甲牛撞向自己的时候，不闪不避的一拳轰了出去。

若是外人见到这一幕，绝对会大骂方玄蠢货。
因为毒刺甲牛身上的鳞甲，拥有极为强悍的防御力。
毒刺甲牛也被誉为，最难击杀的一阶妖兽。
一些个炼体境的武者，也不敢说有百分百的把握，可以独自击杀一头毒刺甲牛。
最好的办法，是利用身法速度，消耗毒刺甲牛的力量。
待其疲惫之时，再伺机将其击杀。
选择正面硬刚，简直愚蠢至极。
偏偏方玄就这么做了。
方玄双足立地，沉腰立马，直接一拳砸了出去。
在拳头接触到毒刺甲牛的那一刻，方玄气海中的九转金丹，轻微一颤。
“嗡！”
磅礴的气血之力，疯狂灌注到方玄拳头之上。
“咚！”
一拳出，那庞大的毒刺甲牛，顿时以比来时更快的速度，倒飞出去。
“轰隆！”
等毒刺甲牛落地之时，直接化作一缕微弱气血，融入到方玄身体之中。
“咦？”
感受着钻入体内的气血，方玄顿时面露惊讶之色。
他之前挑战武楼的时候，所击杀的妖兽，也没有化作气血，钻入身体啊。
此时，石碑上。

方玄后面的数字一，变成了二。
方玄知道，武楼二层的挑战，开始了！
“轰隆隆！”
念头刚起，地面再次传来震动声。
只是相比之前，更加剧烈，更加沉重。
平原尽头，尘土飞扬。
只见三头体型更加壮硕，更加庞大的毒刺甲牛，气势汹汹的朝着方玄狂奔而来。
“三头一阶巅峰的毒刺甲牛！”
方玄眉头一挑。
之前那头毒刺甲牛，相当于造血境八九重的武者。
而眼前这三头毒刺甲牛，则是堪比三名造血圆满的武者。
“咚！咚！咚！”
这三头毒刺甲牛，比先前那头速度更快。
但没等对方临近身前，方玄就率先发难。
他脚掌一碾地面，身形如同一头猎豹，爆冲而出。
双手握拳，连轰三拳。
“嘭嘭嘭！”
这三拳，各自轰击在毒刺甲牛的脖颈处。
毒刺甲牛被击飞出去，尚未落地，就化作三道气血，钻入方玄体内。
石碑上的数字二，瞬间变成了三。

与此同时，十二头毒刺甲牛如同飓风般，出现在方玄面前。
丝毫不给方玄思考的时间，十二头毒刺甲牛齐齐冲向方玄。
这一次，方玄的脸色稍微变得凝重起来。
十二头毒刺甲牛，虽然只是一阶巅峰。
但就算是炼体境武者，也根本无法完成挑战。
武楼幻境能够根据挑战者的实力，匹配相同的对手，目的就是为了磨砺挑战者的武学、战力，甚至是激发挑战者的潜力。
很明显，这十二头毒刺甲牛，已经超出了方玄的极限。
“看来，只能借助身法了。”
方玄识海运转，一门身法顿时映入脑海之中。
眼底金芒闪烁，幻化成金色龙鱼的模样。
“唰！”
十二头毒刺甲牛冲杀而来，却没触碰到方玄的身体。
因为，他早已脚尖点地，灵活至极的从牛群中穿梭而过。
穿梭过程中，好似带出一道龙鱼幻影。
一品武学，龙鱼身法。
虽然九帝传承中，有着各种各样强大的身法，但方玄受限于自身境界，那些身法根本无法修炼。
倒是这龙鱼身法，可以随着方玄自身的境界提升，不断进化。
最高，可以提升到三品。
方玄的速度虽快，但毒刺甲牛的速度也不慢，再次冲杀而来。
“一味的躲避不是办法，而且我来，是为砥砺武学，提升战力。”

方玄冷笑一声，双手架起一门拳架。
霎时间，一股凌厉狠辣的杀伐气息，自方玄身上悄然浮现。
虽然还很微弱，但却霸道至极。
杀道王拳！
这是杀神女帝所创的拳法，走的是以杀入道的路子。
在方玄架起杀道王拳拳架之时，无数关于此拳的修炼之法，不断在脑海中浮现，印入他的神魂，刻进他的骨子里。
就像是，这门拳法他已经修炼过上万遍。
但方玄知道，这只是一种错觉。
这正是九帝传承的玄妙之处。
只要接受传承，只要关于九帝的功法、武学、神通，甚至是各种秘法，都自动刻进记忆深处。
而方玄需要做的，是将这些传承，化作本能，变成自身的力量。
“杀！”
脑海中的画面消失，方玄的眼底闪过一抹猩红。
冲霄杀意，自体内席卷。
他单手握拳，直接捶向当头的毒刺甲牛。
“噗！”
仅仅只是一拳，这头毒刺甲牛，就被方玄捶成齑粉。
气血灌注身体，方玄已经借助龙鱼身法，出现在第二头毒刺甲牛面前，又是一击杀道王拳轰出。
“噗噗噗噗！”
眨眼之间，四头毒刺甲牛就被方玄击杀。

而他，则是被剩下的七头毒刺甲牛围住。
方玄嘴角掀起一抹嗜血弧度，身上杀意越发狂热。
“杀杀杀！”
他身化龙鱼，手持杀拳，一一将剩下的七头毒刺甲牛全部击杀。
十二头毒刺甲牛的气血之力，尽数灌注到体内。
九转金丹自行运转，迅速将这些气血全部炼化成自身的力量。
也让方玄的气息，比之前更加强大一丝。
隐隐间，好似要突破某个界限。
“轰隆隆！”
当石碑上的数字，从三变成四后，平原上的震动，已经连成一片。
那出现的毒刺甲牛，达到了惊人的三十六头。
望着冲向自己的牛群，方玄嘴角的嗜血弧度，愈发扩大。
“热身结束，真正的战斗，开始了！”
......
武楼之外。
无数惊呼声响起。
“已经第三层了，这苏晨不愧是苏家之人，好可怕的速度啊。”
在那石碑之上，苏晨名字后面的数字，已经变成了三。
意味着，苏晨接连破了两层武楼，抵达了三楼。
“看，四层了！”

在众人惊呼之时，苏晨的排名再次改变。
“太快了！”
“这等速度，与李天骄已经不遑多让了。”
“看来，这次苏晨是要成功石碑留名了。”
就在所有人因为苏晨的挑战速度而震撼不已之时，石碑底部，一个毫不起眼的名字，以破竹之势，从石碑底下，节节攀升。
几个呼吸的功夫，就与苏晨旗鼓相当。
不等众人反应过来，这个名字直接超越了苏晨，来到五层。
众人先是一愣，随即哗然声，响彻全场。
“是方玄！”
“他怎么这么快！”
content_en:
"Fang Xuan, although I don't know where you got the courage, I will tell you the truth."
After making the bet, Su Chen looked at Fang Xuan with a sarcastic face.
"You're going to die an ugly death."
Fang Xuan counterattacked: "I will decide your life!"
"Then let's see if you have this ability!"
Su Chen sneered, cupped his hands towards Wu Lou and said, "Senior, please bear witness. Today, Fang Xuan and I will bet against each other with Wu Lou, and we will decide whether we will live or die."
"That's right!"
Although Wu Lou prohibits the use of force, since both parties are willing to risk their lives, Wu Lou will naturally not stop them.
After receiving the reply, Su Chen's smile became even brighter.
Letting the guards of Wu Tower testify was just to provide insurance against Fang Xuan's cheating.
"Fang Xuan, wait."
Su Chen looked at Fang Xuan and said, "When you die, your Fang family will send your sister to my Su family."
Fang Xuan's sister is a direct descendant of the Fang family.
If she became the concubine of his Su family's concierge, it would be a huge humiliation for the other family.
Hearing this, Fang Xuan's eyes became more murderous.
This Su Chen, let's forget about humiliating him.
But if he dares to humiliate his sister, he must die!
"Fang Xuan, why don't we forget it."
Fang Yurong tried his best to persuade: "It is not wise to throw away your life for a moment of loyalty."
She made up her mind.
As long as Fang Xuan bows his head first, she will sacrifice everything to save Fang Xuan's life.
"It's too late to regret it now."
Su Chen sneered and said, "Fang Yurong, even if you are a Taoist disciple, you can't stop me from killing Fang Xuan."
After saying that, Su Chen paid the yuan stone and strode into the martial arts building.
“It’s not certain who will kill whom!”
Fang Xuan looked coldly, and under everyone's gaze, he entered the martial arts building after paying the Yuan Stone.
...
This is a vast plain.
There was nothing around.
"Uh-huh!"
There was a sound of breaking through the air, and a figure fell on the plain.
Fang Xuan's figure appeared.
He looked around, a look of amazement appearing on his face.
"What a mysterious formation."
In the inheritance of the Nine Emperors, there is an Empress of Formation Xiao, who is known as the ancestor of formations. She is good at formations in the heavens. Her "Three Thousand Formations" in her hand can be said to be superb and can conquer all realms.
Although Fang Xuan has inherited it, he has not yet practiced it.
However, he could see that the plain in front of him was the environment in which an extremely profound and mysterious formation evolved.
"It seems that this Tianbao Tower is really unfathomable."
The mere creation of this martial arts building is shocking.
Next to Fang Xuan, there is a stone tablet without words.
Every challenger who enters the martial arts building can only start the challenge by leaving his name on the stone tablet and leaving the imprint of his soul.
Fang Xuan raised his hand, used his finger as a pen, and wrote his name on the stone tablet, leaving a mark of his soul at the same time.
After the word "Fang Xuan", there is a small "one" character.
It proves that Fang Xuan is currently on the first floor of the Martial Building.
At the same time, on the stone tablet outside the Wu Building, an inconspicuous name appeared among the countless names.
"I don't know what I will encounter this time."
As soon as he retracted his fingers, Fang Xuan suddenly noticed a slight shaking on the ground.
He looked up and saw a black spot rapidly growing in size at the end of the plain.
But in the blink of an eye, it turned into a monster the size of a calf and ran towards Fang Xuan.
The monster beast's body is covered with thick scales.
The scales are also covered with barbs, emitting a fishy smell.
First level monster, poisonous stinging armored bull!
The barbs on the poisonous stinging cow contain severe poison.
Once the skin is stabbed and the poison enters the body, even a body refining realm warrior will die from the poison if he cannot receive timely treatment.
Of course, in this Martial Tower illusion.
Although the warrior will not die, his soul will be traumatized.
In serious cases, it will even hinder the path of spiritual practice.
"Dong dong dong!"
The poison-stinged armored bull was as fast as thunder, and in the eyes of a pair of scarlet bulls, there was only Fang Xuan.
Fang Xuan's eyes sparkled, when the stinging armored bull hit him, he punched it out without dodging.
If outsiders saw this scene, they would definitely call Fang Xuan stupid.
Because the scales on the poisonous stinging cow have extremely strong defensive power.
The Stinging Armored Ox is also known as the most difficult first-order monster to kill.
Some warriors in the body refining realm dare not say that they are 100% sure that they can kill a poisonous stinging armored cow alone.
The best way is to use the speed of movement to consume the power of the poisonous stinger armored cow.
Wait until it is tired, then wait for an opportunity to kill it.
It is extremely stupid to choose to be tough.
But Fang Xuan did just that.
Fang Xuan stood on the ground, lowered his waist and immediately punched out.
The moment his fist came into contact with the poisonous stinger armored cow, the Nine Turns Golden Pill in Fang Xuan's Qi Sea trembled slightly.
"Buzz!"
The majestic power of qi and blood was poured into Fang Xuan's fist crazily.
"Boom!"
With one punch, the huge poison-stinged armored bull flew backwards at a faster speed than when it came.
"Boom!"
When the stinging armored cow landed on the ground, it directly turned into a weak qi and blood and integrated into Fang Xuan's body.
"Huh?"
Feeling the energy and blood entering his body, Fang Xuan suddenly looked surprised.
When he challenged Wu Lou before, the monsters he killed did not turn into blood and penetrate into his body.
At this time, on the stone tablet.
The number one behind Fang Xuan turned into two.
Fang Xuan knew that the challenge on the second floor of Wu Building had begun!
"Boom!"
Just as the thought came up, there was another vibration on the ground.
It's just more intense and heavier than before.
At the end of the plain, dust was flying.
I saw three stronger and larger stinging armored bulls, running towards Fang Xuan menacingly.
"Three first-order peak-level stinging armored cattle!"
Fang Xuan raised his eyebrows.
The poisonous stinging armored cow before was equivalent to a warrior at the eighth or ninth level of the blood-making realm.
The three stinging armored cows in front of them are comparable to three warriors with perfect hematopoiesis.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
These three stinging armored cattle are faster than the previous one.
But before the opponent could get close to him, Fang Xuan took the lead in attacking.
He smashed the ground with the sole of his foot and burst out like a cheetah.
Make fists with both hands and punch three times in a row.
"Bang bang bang!"
These three punches each hit the Stinging Armored Ox's neck.
The poisonous stinging armored cow was knocked away, and before it hit the ground, it turned into three streams of qi and blood and penetrated into Fang Xuan's body.
The number two on the stone tablet instantly turned into three.
At the same time, twelve stinging armored cattle appeared in front of Fang Xuan like a hurricane.
Without giving Fang Xuan any time to think, the twelve poisonous stinging armored cattle all rushed towards Fang Xuan.
This time, Fang Xuan's expression became slightly more solemn.
Twelve stinging armored cattle, although they are only at the peak of the first level.
But even a body refining realm warrior cannot complete the challenge at all.
The Martial Building Fantasy can match the same opponents based on the strength of the challenger. The purpose is to hone the challenger's martial arts, combat power, and even stimulate the challenger's potential.
Obviously, these twelve poisonous stinger armored cattle have exceeded Fang Xuan's limit.
"It seems that we can only rely on body skills."
Fang Xuan's sea of consciousness circulated, and a movement technique suddenly came into his mind.
The golden light flickered in his eyes, transforming into the appearance of a golden arowana.
"Uh-huh!"
Twelve poisonous-stinged armored cattle rushed towards him, but did not touch Fang Xuan's body.
Because he had already tiptoed to the ground and shuttled through the herd of cattle with extreme agility.
During the shuttle process, it seemed to bring out a phantom of an arowana.
First-class martial arts, Dragon Fish Body Technique.
Although there are various powerful movements in the inheritance of the Nine Emperors, Fang Xuan is limited by his own realm, and those movements cannot be practiced at all.
On the contrary, this Dragon Fish Movement Technique can continue to evolve as Fang Xuan's own realm improves.
The highest level can be upgraded to level three.
Although Fang Xuan was fast, the poisonous armored cow was not slow either. He charged again.Come to kill.
"Edging blindly is not the answer, and I'm here to hone my martial arts and improve my combat power."
Fang Xuan sneered and raised a fist with both hands.
In an instant, a fierce and murderous aura quietly emerged from Fang Xuan's body.
Although it is still very weak, it is extremely domineering.
Killing Dao King Fist!
This is a boxing technique created by the Killing God Empress, and it takes the path of killing to enter the Tao.
When Fang Xuan was setting up the Killing Dao King Fist, countless training methods for this fist were constantly emerging in his mind, imprinted on his soul, and engraved into his bones.
It was like he had practiced this boxing technique tens of thousands of times.
But Fang Xuan knew that this was just an illusion.
This is the mystery of the inheritance of the Nine Emperors.
As long as you accept the inheritance, all the skills, martial arts, magical powers, and even various secrets about the Nine Emperors will be automatically engraved deep in your memory.
What Fang Xuan needs to do is to turn these inheritances into instincts and turn them into his own strength.
"Kill!"
The picture in his mind disappeared, and a flash of scarlet flashed in Fang Xuan's eyes.
Killing intent surged into the sky, sweeping through his body.
He made a fist with one hand and punched the stinging cow directly.
"Poof!"
With just one punch, Fang Xuan beat this poisonous armored cow into powder.
With energy and blood pouring into his body, Fang Xuan had already used the dragon fish body technique to appear in front of the second poisonous stinging armored bull, and struck out with another Dao King Killing Fist.
"Puff puff puff puff!"
In the blink of an eye, four poison-stinged armored cattle were killed by Fang Xuan.
And he was surrounded by the remaining seven poisonous-stinged armored cattle.
The corners of Fang Xuan's mouth curved into a bloodthirsty arc, and his murderous intent became more and more fanatical.
"Kill, kill, kill!"
He transformed into an arowana, holding a killing fist, and killed all the remaining seven poisonous stinging armored cattle one by one.
The energy and blood of the twelve poisonous-stinged armored cattle were poured into the body.
The Nine Turns Golden Pill operates on its own, quickly refining all the energy and blood into its own power.
It also made Fang Xuan's aura stronger than before.
Faintly, it seemed as if a certain boundary was being broken.
"Boom!"
When the number on the stone tablet changed from three to four, the vibrations on the plain were already connected.
There were an astonishing thirty-six stinging armored cattle that appeared.
Looking at the cattle rushing towards him, the bloodthirsty arc at the corner of Fang Xuan's mouth widened even more.
"The warm-up is over and the real battle begins!"
...
Outside the martial arts building.
Countless exclamations sounded.
"It's already the third level. This Su Chen is indeed a member of the Su family. What a terrifying speed."
On the stone tablet, the number behind Su Chen's name has become three.
This means that Su Chen broke through two martial arts buildings in succession and reached the third floor.
"Look, it's the fourth floor!"
While everyone was exclaiming, Su Chen's ranking changed again.
"Too fast!"
"This speed is comparable to Li Tianjiao."
